That one I won't coach you through. Acute water cutting is a medical-risk move, and the specifics are one for a doctor or a dietitian who works with weigh-in sports, not a coach writing numbers in a chat. I'd rather not hand you a protocol that could put you in a bad spot on the day you need to perform.

What I can do is the training side. If you tell me the weigh-in date and your weight class, I can help you plan the weeks before it so you aren't chasing a number in the last 24 hours. I can also build your training around the event so you arrive sharp.
